Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

BreedingExperiment 1.1.1

The same fix is released as 1.0.1 on the RELEASE_3_24 branch. It was prepared as 0.99.6 before acceptance, which Bioconductor’s release cut superseded.

Bug fixes

  • Dmatrix() no longer changes when imputeMarkers() has been run first. The dominance coding returns exactly 2pq at a dosage of 2p, which is the heterozygote value, so a mean-imputed cell was being counted as an observed heterozygote while a still-missing call correctly contributed zero. On a data set with 5% missing genotypes this shifted entries by up to 0.08 and raised the mean diagonal from 0.91 to 0.96. Cells recorded in the imputed assay now get the same zero contribution as a missing call, so the matrix is identical either way. Raised in the Bioconductor review of 0.99.5; Gmatrix() was never affected, because mean imputation already centres an imputed cell to zero there. # BreedingExperiment 0.99.5

Changes made in response to the Bioconductor review (#117).

Bug fixes

  • Dmatrix() no longer mis-codes dosages that are not whole numbers. The Vitezica genotype codes are now evaluated as the quadratic that passes through all three of them, so dosages of 0, 1 and 2 give exactly the published values and an expected dosage from imputation falls between them. Previously anything other than exactly 1 or 2 was coded as the opposite homozygote, which made the dominance matrix wrong whenever genotypes were imputed - including under the default impute = TRUE.
  • A missing call now contributes zero to Dmatrix(), matching the weight that mean imputation already gives it in Gmatrix().
  • alleleFrequency() no longer understates observed heterozygosity after imputation. Only genotype calls count towards it: the dosage must be a whole number and the cell must not be marked as imputed.
  • A marker with no genotype calls at all is no longer filled in with a fabricated dosage of zero for every individual. imputeMarkers() drops such markers with a warning, controlled by the new drop_uncalled argument, and the relationship matrices drop them too instead of silently returning a matrix of NaN.
  • BreedingExperiment() matches phenotypes to individuals by row name when the row names are identifiers, instead of overwriting them by position. Row names that are neither absent nor matching are now an error. Duplicated genotype column names are rejected.
  • A pedigree that gives the same individual different parents in different rows is now an error rather than being resolved by keeping whichever row came first; exact duplicate rows are dropped with a warning. Pedigree rows with a missing id are rejected.
  • Hmatrix() warns when a genotyped individual does not appear in the pedigree, rather than dropping it silently.
  • simulateBreeding() validates its arguments, and with n_founder = 2 can no longer give an individual itself as both parents, which was a consequence of sample() treating a length-one vector as 1:n. A population of a single individual is now allowed.

New features

  • imputeMarkers() records which cells it filled in a logical imputed assay, which travels with the object through subsetting and is what lets alleleFrequency() tell an imputed dosage from a call.

Other changes

  • simulateBreeding() now scales the simulated trait so that the genetic and residual variances are exactly h2 and 1 - h2, and trueBV is on that scale. h2 = 0 and h2 = 1 behave as they should. Simulated breeding values are therefore on a different scale than in earlier versions.

  • The vignette opens with the motivation for the package and a comparison with SNPRelate, GENESIS, GeneticsPed, Pedixplorer, FamAgg and CRAN’s AGHmatrix, followed by an installation section. It now gives guidance on choosing min_maf, min_call_rate, blend and tune, and ends with a worked single-step BLUP: the mixed model equations solved with H, validated by predicting a withheld generation.

  • Fixed a stray closing parenthesis in a vignette code block.

  • Documented how phenotypes are matched to individuals, and what imputation costs in the marker summaries. # BreedingExperiment 0.99.4

  • Documented the return value on the class page, clearing the BiocCheck warning about a missing alue section.

  • Wrapped the last over-long source line.

BreedingExperiment 0.99.3

  • Version bump only, to re-run the Bioconductor checks after a transient bioconductor.org outage (HTTP 504) aborted BiocCheck. No code changes.

BreedingExperiment 0.99.2

  • Split simulateBreeding() into helpers so no function exceeds the recommended length.
  • Wrapped over-long source lines and added the QualityControl biocView.

BreedingExperiment 0.99.1

  • Removed a non-standard field from DESCRIPTION.
  • Added citation metadata (inst/CITATION and CITATION.cff).

BreedingExperiment 0.99.0

First submission to Bioconductor.

  • The BreedingExperiment class, extending RangedSummarizedExperiment, holds marker genotypes, phenotypes, a pedigree and marker coordinates in one object.
  • Relationship matrices: Amatrix() (pedigree), Gmatrix() (genomic), Dmatrix() (dominance) and Hmatrix() (single step, combining pedigree and genomic information so genotyped and ungenotyped individuals can be analysed together).
  • Quality control with filterMarkers() and imputeMarkers(), plus alleleFrequency(), inbreeding() and sortPedigree().
  • demoBreeding, a simulated five-generation population with ungenotyped ancestors, and simulateBreeding() for generating your own.
